tools.name: scrape
tools.description: Turn any public web page into clean, LLM-ready Markdown, raw HTML or JSON fields picked with CSS selectors. Optional JavaScript rendering, screenshots and an automatic residential-proxy fallback when a site blocks. Costs from 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: youtube-transcripts
tools.description: Transcripts of YouTube videos with timestamps, chapters, language choice and video metadata. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: facebook-ads-library
tools.description: Search the Facebook Ad Library by keyword or advertiser Page ID: ad text, images, videos, CTA, run dates and platforms. No login, no browser. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: linkedin-jobs
tools.description: Search LinkedIn job postings by keyword, location, date posted, work type, experience level and job type: title, company, location, full description, seniority, employment type and applicant count. No login, no browser. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: indeed-jobs
tools.description: Search Indeed job postings by keyword, job title, company, location and posted date: title, company, rating, salary, job type, benefits, the full description and the employer’s website and size. No login, no browser. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: amazon-products
tools.description: Search amazon.com by keyword and get product listings: title, price, list price, rating, review count, image, badges (Amazon’s Choice / Best Seller) and URL. No login, no browser. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: amazon-reviews
tools.description: Get the reviews embedded on an amazon.com product page by ASIN or URL: rating, title, date, verified purchase, helpful votes and full text. No login, no browser. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: reddit
tools.description: Read subreddit listings, run searches or fetch one post with its comments: title, author, text/body, link, created date and permalink. No login, no browser. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: zillow
tools.description: Search Zillow for-sale listings by city/location: price, beds, baths, square footage, Zestimate, home type and status. No login, no browser. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: maps-leads
tools.description: Find businesses on Google Maps by type and location (optionally within a radius): name, address, phone, website, rating, reviews, categories and opening hours, plus emails (with the page they were found on), phone numbers and social profiles from each business website. One row per company. No login,

tools.name: serp
tools.description: Search results from Bing and DuckDuckGo as structured JSON: organic results with position, title, URL and snippet, Bing ads and related searches, result count, pagination, country and language. No browser, no Google. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: threads
tools.description: Scrape public Threads posts by keyword search, profile or post URL: text, author, likes, replies, reposts, images, videos, links, mentions, profile details and the first page of replies. No login, no browser. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: website-contacts
tools.description: Get email addresses, phone numbers and Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok and Pinterest profiles from a list of company websites: homepage plus contact and imprint pages. No login, no browser. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

tools.name: linkedin-company
tools.description: Get public LinkedIn company data from a company URL or website domain: industry, size, employees on LinkedIn, headquarters and address, all locations, website, type, founding year, specialties, followers, similar companies and recent posts. No login. Costs 1 credit per result; failed items are free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scrape, amazon-products, amazon-reviews, reddit, serp, threads, website-contacts, linkedin-company · Private data: website-contacts · Public sink: reddit, threads, website-contacts · Destructive: facebook-ads-library, reddit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scrape, amazon-products, amazon-reviews, reddit, serp, threads, website-contacts, linkedin-company · Private data: website-contacts · Public sink: reddit, threads, website-contacts · Destructive: facebook-ads-library, reddit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
